title: CloudCode
description: Build your own cloud-based code editor from scratch using Java. Learn how to design real-time collaboration, containerized execution environments, and distributed file systems.
longDescription: CloudCode is a comprehensive project-based system where you build a fully functional cloud IDE with Java Spring Boot. From the WebSocket collaboration layer to Docker-based code execution, you'll learn every piece of modern cloud architecture by building it yourself in Java.
author: 100xSystems
